title: Crowns and presence (Berakhot 17a)
hook: in the world to come there's no eating or drinking; the righteous sit with crowns and enjoy the Presence
tomorrow: a teacher makes a student stand all lesson long. then what?

segments.voice: Yesterday, the town and the field: much or little, the heart. Today, a picture of what's left when the work is done.

At some concerts, they lock your phone in a pouch at the door. For the first few minutes, people don't know what to do with their hands. Then something shifts, and they're just there. Rav had a favorite saying about the world to come, and it strips away far more than a phone. No food, no rivals, no deadlines. So what is left? Something you can't eat and can't win.
screen: `THE PHONE IN A POUCH.` → `NO FOOD, NO RIVALS.` → `SO WHAT'S LEFT?`

segments.voice: Here's Rav's saying, in plain words. The world to come is not like this world. There's no eating and no drinking there, no having children, no business, no jealousy, no hatred, no competition. Instead, the righteous sit with their crowns on their heads and enjoy the radiance of the Shechinah, God's presence. Then he gives a verse. When the elders went up the mountain with Moses, Exodus says "they beheld God, and did eat and drink." Rav reads it this way: the beholding was their food and drink. The presence itself fed them. Now look again at what's gone from his list. Not only hunger. Jealousy, hatred, competition: the whole engine of comparing. Nobody's checking whose crown is shinier. Here's the part to tell a friend tonight. In this picture, the reward isn't a feast or a prize ceremony. It's being fully present, with nothing to earn. Rav's is one picture of the world to come among several in Jewish teaching. But it turns a quiet question back on this world: if presence is what lasts, how much of it is getting crowded out?
screen: `NO EATING, NO DRINKING.` · `NO JEALOUSY, NO COMPETITION.` · `CROWNS, AND THE RADIANCE OF THE PRESENCE.` · `BEHOLDING WAS THEIR FOOD.` · then, large: `CROWNS AND PRESENCE.`

segments.voice: Put down whatever is in your hands. For the rest of the sit, only take in this room: one sound, the light on one surface, the weight of your body where you sit. No task and no score, just being here.
screen: `HANDS EMPTY.` · `ONE SOUND, ONE LIGHT, YOUR WEIGHT.` · `NOTHING TO EARN.`

segments.voice: Crowns and presence. Rav's world to come: no food, no rivals, the righteous crowned and fed by the radiance of the Shechinah.
Crowns and presence: that's the line, with nothing to earn and nobody to beat. Fifteen of fifty in Berakhot.
